 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Divider rows/columns are full lines of a common non-background color.
    div_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1 and g[r][0] != 0]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == g[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h))]
    # Consecutive divider intersections reveal the grid's frame color.
    color = g[div_rows[0]][0] if div_rows else g[0][div_cols[0]]
    div_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == color for v in g[r])]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == color for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + div_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + div_cols + [w]
    bands = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    panels = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
    # Pair panels from the right, leaving a lone leading panel unpaired if needed.
    pairs = []
    j = len(panels) - 1
    while j > 0:
        pairs.append((panels[j - 1], panels[j]))
        j -= 2
    for (r0, r1) in bands:
        for (left, right) in pairs:
            l0, l1 = left
            r0c, r1c = right
            # Only complete a pair when exactly one panel contains an object.
            left_has = any(g[r][c] not in (0, color) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(l0, l1))
            right_has = any(g[r][c] not in (0, color) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(r0c, r1c))
            if left_has == right_has:
                continue
            src0, src1, dst0 = (l0, l1, r0c) if left_has else (r0c, r1c, l0)
            # Reflect the source panel horizontally into the paired panel.
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(src0, src1):
                    value = g[r][c]
                    if value not in (0, color):
                        dc = dst0 + (src1 - 1 - c - src0)
                        g[r][dc] = value
    return g
"
